sol_t_compress_image_text: Bring JPG, PNG and WebP photos under the size a form or site asks for. Runs on your device.
sol_t_compress_50kb_text: The most common upload limit for job, school and government portals.
sol_t_compress_100kb_text: A little more room for detail, still small enough for most portals.
sol_t_compress_200kb_text: Profile pictures, listings and blog images that still look sharp.
sol_t_heic_jpg_text: Turn iPhone photos into JPGs that open on any computer, app or website.
sol_t_hif_jpg_text: Make Canon, Sony and Fujifilm HIF photos readable everywhere.
sol_t_heif_jpg_text: Convert any HEIF photo, including several at once, to standard JPG.
sol_t_avif_jpg_text: Open modern AVIF downloads in older apps, email and upload forms.
sol_t_jxl_jpg_text: Turn JPEG XL files into JPGs for apps that cannot open them yet.
sol_t_webp_jpg_text: Save web images as JPG for printing, editing or uploading.
sol_t_webp_png_text: Keep transparent stickers and logos sharp as lossless PNG.
sol_t_hif_avif_text: Shrink camera HIF photos into small AVIF files that keep 10-bit colour.
sol_t_jpg_jxl_text: Re-encode JPGs as JPEG XL to save space without losing detail.
sol_t_avif_jxl_text: Move AVIF images to JPEG XL for a single high-quality format.
sol_t_svg_webp_text: Rasterise vector art to WebP at the size you need, with transparency.
sol_t_svg_avif_text: Rasterise icons and illustrations to tiny AVIF files.
sol_t_svg_png_text: Pixel-perfect PNGs from any SVG, at any width.
sol_t_png_jxl_text: Lossless PNG to JPEG XL, usually much smaller.
sol_t_bg_remover_text: Cut out the subject and download a transparent PNG or WebP.
sol_t_bulk_square_text: Crop a whole batch to perfect squares, centred on the subject.
sol_t_ebay_resizer_text: Size and convert listing photos to what eBay recommends.
sol_t_sdr_hdr_text: Give a photo HDR highlights that light up on HDR screens.
sol_t_images_pdf_text: Combine photos and scans into one PDF, one image per page.
sol_t_heic_pdf_text: Turn iPhone photos straight into a shareable PDF.
sol_t_compress_pdf_text: Make a PDF small enough for an email or an upload portal.
sol_t_mp4_webm_text: Convert MP4 to smaller, web-friendly WebM right in your browser.
sol_t_webm_mp4_text: Turn WebM into MP4 that plays on phones, Macs and Windows.
sol_meta_description: Every Mochifile tool in one place: compress photos to a target size today, with converters, PDF and video tools coming. Free and private, in your browser.
sol_lead: Each tool does one job: drop your files and download the result. HEIC, HIF and AVIF to JPG, JPEG XL encoding, transparent cut-outs, square crops and PDFs. No account needed and no monthly limit. Need something that is not listed? Describe it in [[ask|Ask Mochifile]].
sol_lead_note: Compress image is open today; the other tools are on their way.
sol_search_text: Find a tool, for example HEIC, WebP or transparent
sol_which_1_item_1: A photo from an iPhone or iPad (.heic): [[heic-jpg|HEIC to JPG]], or [[heic-pdf|HEIC to PDF]] to put several in one document.
sol_which_1_item_2: A photo from a Canon, Sony or Fujifilm camera (.hif): [[hif-jpg|HIF to JPG]].
sol_which_1_item_3: An AVIF or JPEG XL file someone sent you: [[avif-jpg|AVIF to JPG]] or [[jxl-jpg|JXL to JPG]].
sol_which_1_item_4: A web image saved as .webp: [[webp-jpg|WebP to JPG]], or [[webp-png|WebP to PNG]] to keep the transparent background.
sol_which_2_title: Smaller files for a form or the web
sol_which_2_item_1: A portal says “maximum 50 KB”: [[compress-50kb|Compress to 50 KB]], or pick any size in [[compress-image|Compress image]].
sol_which_2_item_2: Faster pages: [[jpg-jxl|JPG to JXL]], or convert to WebP and AVIF in [[ask|Ask Mochifile]].
sol_which_2_item_3: Logos and icons: [[svg-webp|SVG to WebP]], [[svg-avif|SVG to AVIF]] or [[svg-png|SVG to PNG]].
sol_which_3_item_1: A square photo for every product: [[bulk-square|Bulk square cropper]].
sol_which_3_item_2: A cut-out on a transparent background: [[bg-remover|Background remover]].
sol_which_3_item_3: eBay says the photo is too small or the wrong type: [[ebay-resizer|eBay image resizer]].
sol_which_4_item_1: Several images in one PDF: [[images-pdf|Images to PDF]] or [[heic-pdf|HEIC to PDF]].
sol_which_4_item_2: A PDF that is too big to send: [[compress-pdf|Compress PDF]].
sol_which_4_item_3: Video for the web or for a phone: [[mp4-webm|MP4 to WebM]] and [[webm-mp4|WebM to MP4]], converted in your browser.
sol_about_1_title: Tool pages, Ask Mochifile or the API?
sol_about_1_text: A tool page is the quickest route when the job matches a single fixed conversion: nothing to learn. For anything else, [[ask|Ask Mochifile]] takes a plain-English request, like “remove the background, transparent PNG” or “square crop and optimise for eBay”, and does the job in one pass. In Chrome, the [[extension|extension]] adds a right-click “Convert to” menu to any image on the web. For folders and automation, the [[cli|CLI, the MCP servers and the REST API]] use the same engine. These are planned, and not available yet.
sol_about_2_text: Browser tools open, convert and save your files inside your own browser tab: nothing is uploaded. Tools that need a server will tell you before you start, send files over an encrypted connection, process them in memory and delete them when the job ends. The [[architecture|architecture page]] has the details.
sol_faq_1_a: Yes. Every tool here is free to use, with no account and no monthly limit. Paid plans are planned, but not available yet.
sol_faq_2_q: Do I need to install anything or sign up?
sol_faq_2_a: No. Open a tool page and drop your files. There are no accounts yet.
sol_faq_3_a: Not by the browser tools: they work inside your own browser tab, so nothing is sent to a server. Any tool that would need a server will say so before you start.
sol_faq_4_q: Can I convert a whole folder at once?
sol_faq_4_a: Compress image takes up to 20 photos at a time, 50 MB each, and gives you a ZIP. Folders and bigger batches are planned for the command line.
sol_faq_5_q: What if the conversion I need is not listed?
sol_faq_5_a: Describe it in Ask Mochifile, which is planned to turn a plain-English request into the right steps. It is not available yet.
sol_faq_6_q: Which image format should I convert to?
sol_faq_6_a: JPG opens everywhere, so it is the safe choice for forms and email. PNG keeps transparency. WebP and AVIF make web pages lighter.
sol_soon_text: We are still building this part of Mochifile. Today you can compress an image to the size you need, free and in your browser.
